answer: Require each agent to forge a stake-backed work bond before it can transact: lock a deposit that is slashed if peers catch duplicate identities, and publish a public activity log so clones are easy to spot. Like a canyon that admits only one river at a time, the bond forces an attacker to pay per identity, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand bonds. Honest agents earn the bond back over time, and dawn audits, random spot-checks at each epoch start, catch dormant sockpuppets before they can vote.
